nav.title: AI Kontak Sentar
nav.subtitle: Sevis blong helpem yu long plante lanwis, wetem janis blong pas long wan man.

stats.catalogueRowsNote: Lis we yu putum i stap olsem
stats.uniqueCodes: Ol kod blong lanwis we i defdefren
stats.uniqueCodesNote: Ol kod we i sem, bae oli gat mak
stats.providerQualificationNote: Ol lanwis we oli bin tes long wan narafala fasin nomo oli kaon
stats.liveQueueNote: Ol janis blong wan tenant nomo

customer.title: Statem wan toktok
customer.consentText: Mi agri se AI provaeda we oli setem, i save wokem toktok ya. Ol tekis oli kodem bifo oli sevem.
customer.setupHint: I no save yusum inaf wan edministreta i setem ekripsen ki mo AI provaeda.
customer.noConversation: I no gat toktok we i stap ron
customer.startHint: Mekem wan sesen wetem agrimen blong statem.
customer.chatEmpty: Ol mesej bae oli kamaot long ples ya. Ol AI aksen oli sagesen nomo; i no gat pemen, jenis long akaon, ripan, no dispajem we i kasem.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Voes long brawsa i go long provaeda we oli setem; OpsCore i no talem se hem i kipim raw odio.
customer.voiceRequirement: Voes long brawsa i nidim HTTPS (o localhost), wan maekrofon, agrimen, wan Realtime model we oli setem, mo provaeda ki. Hem i no wan PSTN/SIP fon bris.

queue.eyebrow: WAN MAN I MAS KAM LONG
queue.title: Laen blong eskaleisen
queue.description: Ol toktok we i gat bigfala resk, i no finis, o we wan man i askem, bae oli kamaot long ples ya. Wan aetem long laen i min se oli askem, i no min se i konek.
queue.empty: I no gat janis blong man i stap long organaesesen ya.
queue.replyStorageNote: Ol ansa blong man oli kodem taem oli stap, mo oli save lukluk long toktok tekis.
queue.resolveNote: Wan man operata we i gat asaenmen i finisim.

boundaries.title: Ol limit blong wok
boundaries.automateBody: Fas ansa long plante lanwis, askem moa, sotem intent mo resk, sef stoa blong tekis, mekem laen mo givim wok long wan agent.
boundaries.humanBody: Wan man i askem klia, konfidens i smol, resk i bigwan o kritikal, i no gat polisi, kes i no finis, kompleen long praevesi o sekuriti, o aksen i no klia.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: I no ON long pekej ya nomo
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imel rutin, laef telefon bris, CRM identiti jek mo ol talem long kwaliti blong lanwis, oli nidim wan tru provaeda adapta, ol kredensol mo ol akseptens tes.

handoffReasons.voice_review_required: I nidim wan luk long voes

messages.qualificationNotice: I no gat wan lanwis we i kwalifae blong produkson inaf ol tes blong tekis, ASR, TTS, aksen mo eskaleisen oli pas.
messages.configOk: Konfigurasen i stap. Konekson blong provaeda mo kwaliti blong lanwis i nidim yet ol laef akseptens tes.
messages.conversationCreated: Sef toktok i mekem finis. Kwaliti blong lanwis i no kwalifae yet blong produkson.
messages.handoffQueued: Janis blong man i stap long laen ({reason}). Hemia i wan askem long laen, i no wan laef konekson.
messages.aiResponseFailed: AI ansa i no finis. I no gat aksen we i bin mekem. Yu save askem wan man blong ansa.
messages.apiUnavailable: Contact Center API i no save load. Saenin long OpsCore konsol, afta loadem pej ya bakegen.
messages.suggestedNextStep: Sagesen blong nekis step nomo (i no bin mekem): {step}.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Janis blong man i stap long laen ({reason}). Laen i no pruvum se wan agent i konek.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Janis blong man i stap long laen. AI sesen long brawsa i stop; laef telefon transfa i no setem.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: I askem wan sot voes kredensol…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Realtime provaeda i talem se wan eror i stap. Stopem voes sesen mo traem bakegen afta yu jekem konfigurasen blong provaeda.
messages.voiceActive: Voes sesen i stap. Presem “Askem wan man” long eni taem; hemia i mekem wan aetem long laen, i no wan PSTN transfa.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Agrimen i nidim bifo wan toktok i save statem.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: I no save ridim ansa blong sava.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: I no save kasem realtime voes provaeda.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Brawsa ya i no sapotem realtime voes.
errors.HANDOFF_NOT_CLAIMED: I no save tekem janis blong man.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE: Mesej we i sem, i no kaon.
